name: Penny Ann's Two Eggs Any Style with Grilled Ham & White Toast
whyItWorks: Fresh eggs scrambled soft, a slice of grilled lean ham, and toasted white bread with seedless jelly. A quintessential flare-safe breakfast combo providing high-quality protein without grease.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request eggs scrambled soft with light cooking spray, grilled ham steak, and plain white toast with jelly. Skip grilled hashbrowns.
